# Gabriela Caballero

> Technical Product Manager at Google, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Works on AI Foundations: the retrieval and context systems that ground AI products in information.

"I solve complex information challenges and build delightful AI experiences by bridging deep technical strategy with user-centric design."

## Experience

- Google, AI Foundations — Product Manager, Zurich (Oct 2026–present): retrieval and context systems for AI.
- Google, YouTube Shopping — Product Manager, Zurich (Mar 2024–Oct 2026): product detection with Gemini-based multimodal models (AI precision 11% → 35.5%), Interactive TV Shopping (+6000% product engagement on TV), auto-timestamps.
- Google Sheets — Product Manager, London (Jul 2022–Mar 2024): led Tables in Google Sheets from 0 to 1, Conditional Notifications, Apps Script & GenAI strategy.
- Google Maps — Associate Product Manager, New York (Aug 2019–Oct 2022): Maps visual search, Street View 15th anniversary (6M+ opt-ins, 16M+ virtual trips).
- Globant — Tech Lead for Disney Parks, Córdoba: team of 6, Java/Spring.
- Intel McAfee — internal IoT monitoring site (Angular).
- Girls Who Code — lead instructor.

## Education

- MS in Management of Technology, New York University — Fulbright Scholar; MoT Capstone award.
- BS in Systems Engineering, Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN-FRC), Córdoba, Argentina.
